reference: single FEM model implemented and solved in COMSOL
problem_detected: S10 predicts the train-induced field increment relative to the environment-matched zero-train case, whereas the frozen B2 historical metrics and fields describe total response. Their raw errors are not directly comparable.
prohibited_reconstruction: Never add the observed FEM base-case field to an S10 prediction; doing so would inject the numerical target and invalidate surrogate evidence.

comparison_views.target: FEM/COMSOL delta response stored in S10_ORIGINAL_68CASE_DATASET.h5
comparison_views.scope: 64 train-active trajectories; zero-train base cases are exact-zero increment checks, not energetic relative-error samples

comparison_views.target: FEM/COMSOL total response stored in S10_ORIGINAL_68CASE_DATASET.h5
models: cross-fitted B2-base plus S10-increment hybrid total field

selection_and_promotion_rules: Outer targets may not select epochs, hyperparameters, reconstruction rules, or candidates.
Physics-versus-control comparisons use identical incremental targets, folds, epochs, seeds, nodes, times, axes, and units.
B2 comparisons must be same case, same time, same node, same axis, and either both incremental or both total.
A candidate cannot be promoted on incremental error alone; its reconstructed total field must also be audited against frozen B2.
No primary metric by axis may degrade more than 2 percent relative to B2 for a noninferiority claim.
At most two candidates may pass from S10 to S11, and S11 remains blocked until an independent S10 audit explicitly authorizes promotion.

evidence_labels.s10_incremental: nested grouped OOF over historically exposed trajectories; not blind
evidence_labels.total_hybrid: cross-fitted hybrid OOF composition over historically exposed trajectories; not an external or blind test

scientific_limitation: The total hybrid uses a frozen historical B2 OOF base prediction whose historical folds are not identical to the S10 outer folds. This composition must be reported as cross-fitted hybrid evidence and may not be relabeled as a pure S10 nested-fold model or external validation.
